How Police Enforce Speed Limits

Law enforcement uses various techniques such as radar guns, speed cameras, and patrol units to monitor and enforce speed limits. These efforts help reduce accidents caused by excessive speed.

Speeding fines and points on driver licenses serve as deterrents, encouraging safer driving behavior.
